title: QMBL: the Quantum Many-Body Leaderboard
description: A record of the best published variational ground-state energies for lattice Hamiltonians. Every row is ranked by energy and carries an explicit bound_type, so variational, projected, extrapolated and exact results are never mixed, plus the primary paper that produced the number. This snapshot contains 205 instances and 675 rows, of which 182 instances have a record under the rules in RULES.md. Rows carry a baseline flag distinguishing results VarBench computed itself as reference calculations from those it collected from the literature. The initial set of primary references was bootstrapped from the VarBench compilation (Wu et al., Science 386, 296 (2024)), which is credited as a source of references rather than as a parent work.
